words.def: honest and dependable; someone you can count on
words.ex: Check the reviews to make sure the seller is {trustworthy} before you pay.

words.def: to ask too much money for something
words.ex: She felt the seller had {overcharged} her for a worn coat.

words.def: real and honest; not fake or a scam
words.ex: The listing looked too good to be true, but it was completely {legit}.

words.def: the state something is in: good, fair or poor
words.ex: According to the listing, the {condition} was excellent.

words.def: to give something to someone else, often a younger person or the next owner
words.ex: She {handed down} her old sewing machine to her neighbour.

words.es: ecológico / respetuoso con el medio ambiente
words.ex: Buying second-hand is one of the most {eco-friendly} choices you can make.

words.def: a website or app where people buy and sell things to each other
words.ex: I listed my old camera on an online {marketplace} and sold it in a day.

words.def: to talk with someone to agree on a price
words.ex: Both sides needed to {negotiate} to agree a fair price.
